spec.selection_metric: mean monthly Spearman rank IC on validation rows; MSE breaks ties
spec.target_training_clip: 0.1 and 99.9 percentiles learned from each training fold

feature_descriptions.ret_1m: stock return in the prediction month
feature_descriptions.ret_3m: compounded stock return over prediction month and the prior 2 months
feature_descriptions.ret_6m: compounded stock return over prediction month and the prior 5 months
feature_descriptions.momentum_12_2: compounded return from months t-12 through t-2
feature_descriptions.volatility_12m: standard deviation of monthly returns from t-11 through t, requiring at least 6 observations
feature_descriptions.log_mcap: log of absolute month-end price times shares outstanding
feature_descriptions.log_turnover: log of monthly volume divided by shares outstanding
feature_descriptions.log_dollar_volume: log of absolute price times monthly volume
feature_descriptions.market_ret_1m: equal-weighted common-stock return in the prediction month
feature_descriptions.is_nyse: one when the security is listed on NYSE
feature_descriptions.is_amex: one when the security is listed on AMEX
feature_descriptions.is_nasdaq: one when the security is listed on Nasdaq
